description: This file declares the net::HostResolver class and its related nested classes and methods, which handle DNS hostname resolution, request creation, MDNS listening, and configuration within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: HostResolver
classes.description: Represents the DNS hostname resolution system, providing methods to create requests, manage cache, and configure DNS settings.

classes.name: HostResolver::Host
classes.description: Represents a hostname or IP address with optional scheme and port information.

classes.name: HostResolver::ResolveHostRequest
classes.description: Handles an individual hostname resolution request, supporting asynchronous operation and retrieval of DNS results.

classes.name: HostResolver::ProbeRequest
classes.description: Handles activation of DNS probe operations for DoH server testing.

classes.name: HostResolver::HttpsSvcbOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the DNS HTTPS SVCB feature.

classes.name: HostResolver::ManagerOptions
classes.description: Parameters for configuring HostResolverManager and resolver behavior.

classes.name: HostResolver::Factory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating HostResolver instances, allowing injection for testing.

classes.name: HostResolver::ResolveHostParameters
classes.description: Parameters for customizing hostname resolution requests.

classes.name: HostResolver::MdnsListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to mDNS DNS-SD results.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateResolver
methods.description: Creates a new HostResolver associated with a HostResolverManager.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneResolver
methods.description: Creates an independent HostResolver not tied to a global manager, for testing or standalone use.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneContextResolver
methods.description: Creates a ContextHostResolver for testing purposes.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateStandaloneNetworkBoundResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver bound to a specific network handle.

methods.name: HostResolver::AddressListToEndpointResults
methods.description: Converts an AddressList to a list of HostResolverEndpointResults.

methods.name: HostResolver::EndpointResultToAddressList
methods.description: Converts endpoint results back into an AddressList.

methods.name: HostResolver::GetNonProtocolEndpoints
methods.description: Extracts non-protocol endpoints from endpoint results.

methods.name: HostResolver::AllProtocolEndpointsHaveEch
methods.description: Checks if all protocol endpoints have ECH parameters.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateFailingRequest
methods.description: Creates a request that immediately fails with a specified error.

methods.name: HostResolver::CreateFailingProbeRequest
methods.description: Creates a probe request that immediately fails.
